Mr. Ramesh Kumar & Mrs. Urmila Ramesh Kumar Message from the Managing Directors Mr. Ramesh Kumar, Managing Director of Hotel Deepa Comforts is a distinguished property developer and hospitality magnate with an impressive career spanning over 40 years. As a prominent figure in Mangalore's real estate and hospitality industry, he has constructed over 35 Apartment buildings and commercial places in and around Mangalore. Mr. Kumar has established himself as a dedicated and accomplished individual with a proven track record of excellence. Mr. Kumar's entrepreneurial spirit led him to establish Janatha Constructions and its affiliated companies, which have carved a niche for them in Mangalore's real estate landscape. His foray into the hospitality industry began with the launch of Hotel Deepa Comforts in 2008, a 3-star hotel that has become a benchmark for excellence in Mangalore. Mrs. Urmila Ramesh Kumar had begun her professional journey in the nationalized bank, where she developed her skills and gained valuable experience. Subsequently, she transitioned to the hospitality industry, assuming the role of Managing Director at Hotel Deepa Comforts, her commitment to excellence is evident in her various roles, including her current positions as President of Vishwa Billava Mahila Sangha and Vice President of Kudroli Shree Gokarnanatha Kshethra in Mangalore.
